[verse]
The boats are resting in the bay
the water holds the last of day
I hear the gulls above the pier
they call for things I never said
the cranes are sleeping in the dark
a cyclist passes by the gate
I count the lights upon the tide
and every wave brings you back home

[chorus]
Harbour light, harbour light
take me to the other side
Harbour light, harbour light
hold my heart inside your hand
the night is long and I am tired
but you are here and that is fine
Harbour light, harbour light
don't let the darkness stay

[verse]
We walked untill the shops were closed
the streets were quiet, wet and wide
you laughed about an ancient joke
I'm gonna keep that laugh inside
the church bell rang a dozen times
the town wake up beneath the train
we didn't know where we should go
but walking there was not so hard

[bridge]
Thou art the harbour where I rest
the wall that keeps the water out
when everything around me fades
you are the light that burns
The list of reasons are too long
so still, so wide, so bare
'cause I can say it without words
the morning comes, I recieve the sun
